summary: WEC Energy Group and subsidiary Wisconsin Electric Power Company (WEPCO) filed an 8-K disclosing a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Nextera Energy Point Beach LLC to purchase 86% of capacity, energy, ancillary services, and environmental attributes from Units 1 and 2 of the Point Beach Nuclear Plant. Terms: PPA runs from October 6, 2030 through October 5, 2050 (Unit 1) and March 9, 2033 through March 8, 2053 (Unit 2), replacing an existing expiring agreement. PPA requires Public Service Commission of Wisconsin approval; may be terminated if approval not obtained by January 1, 2028 (extendable to July 1, 2028). What to watch: regulatory approval timeline and customer savings versus current agreement.
